result.rationale: The diff line `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` in poll_feed.rb dereferences `i.content` unconditionally. For RSS 2.0 items lacking an atom:content/content:encoded element, simple-rss would not populate `content`, so `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError and aborts the loop, blocking feed imports. The mechanism is visible in the diff; the exact simple-rss behavior is external, so confidence is moderate.
